title: Motorola 6800 16-Bit Minimal Firmware (S19)
description: Clean Motorola S19 firmware image with S0 ASCII header, 16-bit S1 code record at 0x0100, S5 record count, S9 entry point, and exact 1's-complement checksums.

title: MC68HC11 EEPROM Sensor Calibration Table (S19)
description: Motorola 68HC11 internal EEPROM image at 0xB600 storing a 14-point 16-bit thermistor linearization lookup table with S5 record count verification.

title: Motorola 68000 24-Bit Flash Image (S28)
description: 24-bit addressed Motorola S28 image for an M68000 system mapped at 0x008000 containing initial SSP/PC vectors, runtime loop, S5 count, and S8 start address.

title: PowerPC Automotive ECU 32-Bit High-Boot Firmware (S37)
description: 32-bit Motorola S37 firmware targeting an automotive MPC55xx PowerPC ECU boot vector at high unsigned flash address 0xFFF00100 with S7 execution start.

title: Multi-Bank Automotive ECU Bootloader, App & Calibration S37 Image
description: Three-region 32-bit Motorola S37 flash image uniting a bootloader (0x00000000), engine control application (0x00000400), fuel-map calibration table (0x00000800), S5 count, and S7 entry.
